data.one_liner: A StripeTerminal plugin to discover readers, connect to them and process payments.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that wraps the Stripe Terminal SDK for Android and iOS. It enables apps to discover nearby card readers, connect to them via Bluetooth, and process in-person payments, including Tap to Pay.
use_when: You need to accept in-person card payments using Stripe hardware or Tap to Pay on mobile devices.
You want an API that maps closely to the native Stripe Terminal SDKs while exposing streams for listeners.
avoid_when: You only need in-app digital purchases or subscriptions without physical terminal readers.
You require offline mode for payments, which is not supported by this plugin.
strengths: Supports all features of Android and iOS native SDKs, including Tap to Pay.
Uses streams instead of callbacks for listeners to offer a simpler Dart API.
weaknesses: Requires native configuration on Android and iOS (such as Bluetooth permissions and Info.plist modifications).
data.setup_notes: Requires native setup including configuring compileOptions/Kotlin target on Android, and adding Bluetooth permissions, background modes, and Tap to Pay entitlements to Info.plist on iOS.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick flutter_stripe if you want standard online Stripe payments or Apple/Google Pay rather than physical hardware card readers and Stripe Terminal.
